review.subtitle: Bulova Lunar Pilot chronograph 45 mm, black dial, black leather strap. Front relief GLB, round 1.
notes: Built from Bulova's official straight-on render (the supplied photo is angled; it is kept as the 3/4 reference). The head is the same render as the 96B258 (bracelet) at 1.17x, so it uses the same measured parts.

Modelled: brushed case with integrated horns and a polished edge, pusher shoulders at 2 and 4, polished sloped bezel, applied polished index frames with white lume, lume hour and minute hands in a polished frame, white chronograph hand with counterweight, three white subdial needles, fluted crown, 20 mm leather strap with the house curl.

From the photo maps: black dial, chapter ring, tachymeter scale, subdial tracks, date (18), BULOVA and 262 kHz (white print redrawn sharp at 4x); the strap leather with its embossed pattern and stitching from the render.
Heights are a front-relief reading of the official side render.

strap.note: 20 mm black leather (official lug width) from the render's strap rows; straight in the recess between the horns, house curl from the horn tips
